newsitem.title: USA: Cabot Corp says to buy back up to 4 mln shrs.
newsitem.headline: Cabot Corp says to buy back up to 4 mln shrs.

text.p: Cabot Corp said Friday its board has approved the repurchase of up to 4 million shares of its common stock, superseding a share repurchase authorization adopted May 10, 1996.
The company said it has repurchased more than six million shares of its common stock during the past two years.
The company said it plans to continue its previously stated plan of repurchasing shares to offset shares issued under employee compensation plans.
The company said it will continue to monitor market and business conditions to evaluate whether additional share buy backs are appropriate.
The company also said it declared a regular quarterly dividend of $0.10 per share, payable June 13, to stockholders of record May 30.
